soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.53–0.55, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin straight. Frontal peaks strongly raised, with a groove between the two peaks. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, bearing long apical setae, slender subapical setae and short lateral apical setae. Mandibles short and stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge strongly projecting; length 0.49–0.52 times head capsule length and 0.93–0.94 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region narrow and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. Pronotum about 1.52–1.67 times as wide as long, anterior margin composed of two broad arcs with a rather deep incision in the middle, lateral margins and posterior margin forming an arc, the incision at the middle of the posterior margin shallower; about 40 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
